title: The Pursuit of Fairness in Artificial Intelligence Models: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and analyzing foundational literature and case studies (e.g., the COMPAS tool in criminal justice, healthcare resource allocation, and facial recognition) and reviewing mathematical fairness metrics like demographic parity, equalized odds, and predictive equality used to measure racial disparities.

Reviewing literature and empirical examples of gender disparities in algorithmic hiring tools, targeted ad delivery systems, healthcare diagnoses, and NLP models (e.g., ChatGPT language translations), evaluating them through various group and individual fairness definitions.
Examining literature and case studies on AI models in healthcare that exhibit biased medical predictions and incorrect medical attention recommendations across different age groups.
Highlighting documented cases of discrimination against atypical behaviors (e.g., autistic players in gaming environments) through a review of real-world AI failures and automated system deployments.
